plan.analysis: Inclusion is the bottleneck: 139/179 missed, 78% in the smallest size tertile (recall 0.14), median missed 35px vs 90px train median; round 1's 0.3-0.8 prefer_small on only 6 line sources left recall at 0.27, suggesting pastes were too tiny to learn and source diversity was low. Patches (0.66) and scratches (0.625) are healthier but still miss small/low-contrast instances (low-contrast patch recall 0.28; scratch low-size recall 0.46). Missed crops for all three classes are thin, faint, small streaks/blobs, matching the available source shapes.
plan.rationale: Change what failed: drop the sub-0.4 scales that likely produced unlearnable micro-pastes, shift to a learnable small range (0.4-1.2) biased small to target the missed 35-55px instances, and use the full source pool for shape/contrast diversity (inclusion round 1 used only 6 sources). Concentrate the 50-image budget on the worst class (inclusion 30, cumulative 55 < 105 cap) while keeping patches (12) and scratches (8) fed so the shared detector doesn't starve them.
